# Dizigom

> > Dizigom is a Turkish streaming platform offering foreign series from Netflix, Apple TV+, The CW, and other networks with Turkish subtitles.

The site specializes in providing HD streaming of international series including Korean dramas, Netflix originals, superhero shows from DC Comics and Marvel, and historical dramas. Content spans multiple genres with a focus on making global entertainment accessible to Turkish-speaking audiences.

## Key Topics

- Turkish subtitles (Türkçe Altyazılı)
- Netflix series
- Korean dramas (Kore Dizileri)
- Historical drama
- Superhero series (DC Comics, Marvel)
- Mini-series
- The CW network shows
- Apple TV+ content
- Sci-fi drama
- Action series
- 2024-2025 new releases
- BBC productions
- Prime Video originals
- International crime dramas
- Fantasy and supernatural series

## Netflix Originals & Exclusives

- [Biohackers](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/biohackers): German Netflix sci-fi thriller Biohackers with Turkish subtitles
- [Atiye](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/atiye): Turkish Netflix fantasy drama Atiye set in Göbeklitepe and Istanbul
- [Baby Bandito](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/baby-bandito): Chilean Netflix heist comedy-action series Baby Bandito (2024)
- [1994](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/1994): Netflix Mexican documentary miniseries about EZLN & Colosio assassination
- [A Sinister Sect: Colonia Dignidad](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/a-sinister-sect-colonia-dignidad): Netflix documentary about Chilean cult Colonia Dignidad
- [A Man in Full](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/a-man-in-full): Netflix drama miniseries starring Jeff Daniels & Diane Lane (2024)
- [Bet](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/bet): Canadian Netflix fantasy drama about gambling in school setting (2025)
- [45 RPM](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/45-rpm): Spanish 1960s music drama 45 RPM set in Madrid with Turkish subtitles

## Superhero & Action Series

- [Black Lightning](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/black-lightning): Black Lightning DC superhero series with Turkish subtitles on The CW
- [Animal Kingdom](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/animal-kingdom): TNT crime drama Animal Kingdom about family crime with Turkish subtitles

## Historical & Period Dramas

- [Anne Boleyn](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/anne-boleyn): Channel 5 Tudor period drama about Anne Boleyn and Henry VIII
- [Becoming Elizabeth](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/becoming-elizabeth): STARZ historical drama about young Elizabeth I (2022)
- [A Young Doctor's Notebook](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/a-young-doctors-notebook): Bulgakov adaptation starring Jon Hamm & Daniel Radcliffe, Sky Arts series
- [Anita: Director's Cut](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/anita-directors-cut): Disney+ Hong Kong biopic series about singer Anita Mui (2022)

## Mystery & Thriller Series

- [A Good Girl's Guide to Murder](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/a-good-girls-guide-to-murder): BBC Three crime mystery thriller with Emma Myers (2024)
- [Andhera](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/andhera): Prime Video Indian supernatural horror series Andhera set in Mumbai (2025)
- [All Her Fault](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/all-her-fault): Peacock drama thriller miniseries about kidnapping plot (2025)

## International & Specialty Content

- [All the Liquors](https://dizigom104.com/dizi-izle/all-the-liquors): South Korean LGBT romantic comedy series All the Liquors (2023)
